thesis: This episode argues that Amazon and Google are 'apex spawns' with strong track records of acquiring valuable new businesses, while the speaker is skeptical of their retail operations and internal initiatives. It also suggests that meme stocks, crypto, and AMC are bubbles, and provides neutral or bullish views on Berkshire Hathaway, Costco, Tesla, Apple, and IBM.
